"""RoboPaint session driver. All motion uses the public robot client.
Commands and exact submitted targets are preserved beside this file.

import sys,time,json,traceback
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
ROOT=Path('/app/output'); (ROOT/'commands').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot()
quat=np.array([0.,1.,0.,0.])
seq=0
last=np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta['proprio']['now'][7:14])

def submit(poses,note='',cams=('practice_cam',),fps=5):
 global last,seq
 a=np.asarray(poses,dtype=float)
 if a.shape[1]==3: a=np.c_[a,np.tile(quat,(len(a),1))]
 out=[]
 for start in range(0,len(a),160):
  seq+=1; chunk=a[start:start+160]
  d=ROOT/'actions'/f'{seq:04d}'; d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  np.save(d/'targets.npy',chunk)
  (d/'request.json').write_text(json.dumps({'note':note,'before':r.status()}))
  result=r.submit('ee_pose',chunk,dt=.05,cameras=list(cams),video='none',video_fps=fps,note=note)
  result.save(d)
  for cam,img in result.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(ROOT/(cam+'.png'))
  last=np.array(result.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14])
  (ROOT/'state.json').write_text(json.dumps({'seq':seq,'last':last.tolist(),'meta':result.meta}))
  print('CALL',seq,'steps',result.meta.get('control_steps'),'left',result.meta.get('time_left_s'),'tip',np.round(last[:3],5).tolist(),'plan',result.meta.get('plan'),flush=True)
  if result.stopped or result.done: raise RuntimeError('Stopped: '+str(result.meta))
  out.append(result)
 return out

def move(xyz,speed=.04,hold=.3,cams=('practice_cam',),note='move'):
 start=last[:3]; xyz=np.array(xyz)
 n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(xyz-start)/speed/.05)))
 poses=np.linspace(start,xyz,n+1)[1:]
 poses=np.r_[poses,np.tile(xyz,(round(hold/.05),1))]
 return submit(poses,note,cams)

def observe(cams=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'),depth=False,name='obs'):
 o=r.get_obs(cameras=list(cams),depth=depth)
 o.save('/app/runs/'+name)
 for cam,img in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(ROOT/(cam+'.png'))
 return o

print('WORKER READY',flush=True)
while True:
 todo=sorted((ROOT/'commands').glob('*.py'))
 todo=[p for p in todo if not p.with_suffix('.done').exists()]
 if not todo: time.sleep(.2); continue
 p=todo[0]
 try:
  print('RUN',p.name,flush=True)
  exec(compile(p.read_text(),str(p),'exec'),globals())
  p.with_suffix('.done').write_text('ok')
 except Exception:
  err=traceback.format_exc();print(err,flush=True)
  p.with_suffix('.done').write_text(err)
